text:
Type: minimalist white LED desk lamp
Use: focused task light for working or reading at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: white coated steel tube frame, brushed aluminium LED head, grey cord
Colors: white, brushed silver
Shape: single bent tube rising from a triangular loop base, slim bar-shaped light head, flexible neck, very slender and light, small footprint
Feel: clean, sleek, airy, discreet
Goes with: white or light wood desks, pale walls, metal accents; minimalist or Scandinavian home offices

product.name: HRTE
product.description: Easy to use in different places as you can power the lamp through the USB port on your computer or an ordinary power socket.
